description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mattegoda, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520008
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Parcel No. 155 and Parcel No. 38) with detailed information about land ownership, extent, location, and title classification. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements without any government personnel changes or structural administrative matters.
